html:
G'oya

Har bir safardan faqat soatni ajratib olamiz, sana tashlab yuboriladi. Keyin soat bo'yicha guruhlab sanaymiz. Qolgani saralash: avval safarlar soni kamayishi bo'yicha, teng bo'lsa soat bo'yicha.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da soatni EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ...) beradi. U NUMERIC qaytaradi, ::int bilan butun songa aylantiramiz. SQLite'da strftime('%H', ...) ikki xonali matn qaytaradi, '08', uni CAST bilan songa aylantiramiz.

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM started_at)::int AS hour, COUNT(*) AS rides
FROM rides
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM started_at)
ORDER BY rides DESC, hour
Faqat SQLiteSELECT CAST(strftime('%H', started_at) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS rides
FROM rides
GROUP BY strftime('%H', started_at)
ORDER BY rides DESC, hour

Namunada 8-soat va 18-soat uchtadan safar bilan teng. Ikkinchi kalit hour bo'lmasa, ularning tartibi tasodifga qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

PostgreSQL'ning TO_CHAR andozasida HH 12 soatlik soat: 14:20 uchun 02 qaytaradi. Kunduzgi va tungi safarlar bitta guruhga qo'shilib ketadi. 24 soatlik soat uchun HH24 kerak:

Noto'g'riSELECT TO_CHAR(started_at, 'HH')::int AS hour, COUNT(*) AS rides
FROM rides
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rides DESC, hour

Yarim tun ham 0-soat, 24 emas: 2024-05-11 00:00:00 dagi safar hour = 0 qatoriga tushadi.

SQLite'da TIMESTAMP ustuni aslida matn, shuning uchun SUBSTR(started_at, 12, 2) ham soatni beradi. PostgreSQL'da esa bu xato: SUBSTR vaqtni qabul qilmaydi, avval uni matnga aylantirish kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Vaqtni matnga aylantirsangiz, ikkala bazada ham 2024-05-10 08:15:00 chiqadi, soat 12- va 13-belgilarda turadi. Bu so'rov ikkala bazada ishlaydi:

SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(started_at AS TEXT), 12, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS rides
FROM rides
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rides DESC, hour
